findings.title: Industry rows and their sector row measure different things and can disagree in sign and size by tens of points
findings.where: Relative Strength > Sector drill-down / Open all industries; Feature_08_Group_Daily.index_level (SECTOR rows unused) vs official IDX sector index in sector-series.sector; SECTOR_FORMULAS.md section 6
findings.steps: Open Relative Strength, 'Open all industries'. Compare Technology (official IDXTECHNO 1M -9.7%) with its biggest industry Internet Applications & Services (19 members, 1M +9.4%), and Healthcare (-0.4%) with Pharmaceuticals (+8.9%) / Healthcare Providers (-10.6%). Over 252 sessions Transportation & Logistic is -18.2% on the official index but its 3 industries are -55% to -65%.
findings.expected: Either industry returns reconcile with their sector row, or the page says plainly that the sector row is the official free-float index and the industry rows a different, traded-value-weighted index.
findings.actual: The only note is 'an industry's returns come from the weighted index of its stocks'. The same traded-value chain index applied to whole sectors (Feature_08_Group_Daily SECTOR rows) differs from the official index by up to 48 pp over 1Y (Transport -66.5% vs -18.2%; Technology 1M +8.3% vs -9.7%; Healthcare 1M -11.6% vs -0.4%; Properties & Real Estate level 3.79 since 2021 vs official 650 / 922 = -29%). The SECTOR rows' index_level and the series adv/unch/dec are shipped/stored but no page figure uses them, so the divergence is only visible by comparing the two bases. Arithmetic is correct (recomputed to 4 decimals); this is a methodology/disclosure gap, the documented 1D example (-0.16% vs -0.31%) understates it.
findings.evidence: Queries on Feature_08_Group_Daily (SECTOR index_level at 2026-11-26, -20, -60, -252 sessions) vs sector-series.sector; c-script output in /tmp/.../sector_check1/agents_20261127-sector-data (pg/ind_all.txt for the page rows; Tech industries 1M: Internet +9.4, Software +2.8, Electronic Equip +6.7, IT Services -8.1, Networking -30.2, Computer Hardware -2.2).

findings.title: Breadth tab 1D advancers/decliners differ from the Overview and Feature 08 for the same market and date
findings.where: Breadth > Advancers and decliners (1D), Breadth heatmap 'Up 1D'; apps/edge-bff/sector/src/cards/br.ts aud(); CONTRACT section 2/3.2 (adv_1d, series adv/unch/dec)
findings.steps: Open Breadth on 26 Nov: 'IHSG (all)' 1D shows 310 up / 202 flat / 322 down, share 310/834. Open the Overview for the same date: advancers 311, unchanged 204, decliners 323 (838 stocks). Financials: page 27/34/36 of 97, Feature 08 27/35/36 of 98.
findings.expected: The same market/day counts on both pages (the contract says Feature 08 breadth must equal the Overview's), or a visible note that the page counts only stocks with a bar on the previous market session.
findings.actual: The page derives 1D counts from r1d, which is null when the stock has no bar on the previous market session (BBMD, DUTI, RONY, SURE on 26 Nov: thin stocks that did not trade on 25 Nov), so 4 stocks drop out of the denominator and the flat count loses 2. The series' adv/unch/dec (which equal the Overview) are downloaded but unused. Same mechanism makes 1W/1M denominators 830/829 vs 838.
findings.evidence: overview-day-2026-11-26 breadth {'advancers':311,'decliners':323,'unchanged':204}; sector-series.breadth.IHSG adv/unch/dec[-1] = 311/204/323 = Feature_08_Group_Daily; page text pg/tab4.txt 'IHSG (all) 310 202 322 310/834'; r1d null list from sector-day-2026-11-26.

findings.title: Stock detail 'Days' counts the stock's own bars, so it contradicts the 'Since' date for thinly traded stocks
findings.where: Breadth > Stock detail columns Days / Since; words.ts:348 daysTip 'Sessions in the current status'; sector.py status runs over Feature 04 rows
findings.steps: Open Breadth > Stock detail, find INPS (EMA50, 'Above ... 19 ... 27 Aug'). Count market sessions 27 Aug to 26 Nov: 66.
findings.expected: 'Days' = sessions (the tooltip says sessions) consistent with 'Since'.
findings.actual: INPS shows 19 days since 27 Aug (19 Feature 04/price bars in that span, 66 market sessions). Of 1,646 status runs that start inside the 300-session window on 26 Nov, 98 (6%) have days != market sessions since the 'since' date, up to 57 off (PPGL EMA200 48 vs 105; INPS EMA200 206 vs 263; TRUE EMA50 95 vs 151). SECTOR_FORMULAS.md section 7 documents 'baris Feature 04 saham itu sendiri' but the page tooltip does not.
findings.evidence: day-file recount (since vs series calendar): 98/1646; DB: INPS 19 Feature_04 rows and 19 price rows vs 66 IHSG sessions between 2026-08-27 and 2026-11-26.
